title: biscutella intermedia subsp. cuneata
intro: Biscutella intermedia subsp. cuneata, commonly known as Rock Cress, is a plant species within the family Brassicaceae. It is a flowering plant native to mountainous regions of Europe, valued for its medicinal properties and potential health benefits. The plant is rich in antioxidants and has been traditionally used to treat various health conditions, including inflammation and respiratory issues, due to its therapeutic actions, which include expectorant, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents of Rock Cress include glucosinolates, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
